notes.title: Development update version 0.1.8 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone🥷🏽🥷🏽🥷🏽

Good news for players who want to share their cool play videos and want to know how  your avatars are do something. We are pleased to announce the release of a new update with a new recording feature.

[ADDED]
・A new feature has been added to the game: the ability to record a virtual camera (3rd-person viewpoint) video of the game being played. When the in-game menu is opened, a button to start recording appears in the upper right corner of the menu. Recorded videos can be played back in VR. Recorded videos are saved in My Documents on your PC. The video is recorded in MP4 format and FHD size.

[FIXED]
・Fixed a problem in which the license data of VRM, which is automatically loaded at startup, was not displayed.

That's all for this update.
Stay tuned for the next update!
Our development team is always open to your feedback!

See you next time🥰⭐
